summary: Mark Miller, 50, veteran Ouray ice-climbing guide, fell to his death while guiding clients on First Gully (WI 3) near Eureka when an ice bulge broke as he climbed off-rope alongside a client; the clients descended and confirmed he had died from his injuries
notes: Friday-verified (climbing.com 2015-02-04 says "last Friday, January 30"). Taught ice climbing 20+ years, instructor for San Juan Mountain Guides. Run-541 KVNF chunk (parent-corroborated via climbing.com search-index).
